how.title: Live in a few days – updated by chat afterwards
how.subtitle: We build your website, you stay in control with a message. No weeks of waiting, no technical knowledge.

how.step2Text: Our team designs and builds your site within a few days – not weeks.

datenschutz.title: Privacy policy
datenschutz.intro: GDPR placeholder. Replace with a reviewed version before going live.
datenschutz.dataText: When you sign up and message us on WhatsApp or Telegram we store your account details, your mobile number or Telegram ID, message content needed for the website, and the mapping to exactly one website. Purpose: account creation, running your presentation site, support.
datenschutz.legalText: Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (contract / pre-contract) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interest in secure operation).
datenschutz.retentionText: Data is kept while your account exists, then according to statutory retention rules.
datenschutz.rightsText: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. You may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority, in Berlin: Berliner Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit.
datenschutz.messagingText: Messages go through Meta (WhatsApp) or Telegram. Their privacy notices also apply. Only message us if you agree to this processing.

cookies.title: Cookies on easyWebBuilder
cookies.text: Essential cookies keep the site working and are always on. With your consent we will also enable analytics cookies (visit statistics) and marketing cookies (ad effectiveness).
cookies.dialogText: Choose which cookies we may use. You can change your choice at any time.
cookies.essentialText: Required for the site to work, e.g. language and your cookie choice.
cookies.analyticsText: Helps us understand how the site is used (visit statistics).
cookies.marketingText: Measures how effective our advertising is.
